data.gender_notes: Haqqaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Haqqaat is derived from the Arabic word 'Haqq', which means 'truth' or 'reality'. In Islamic tradition, Haqqaat represents the sincere and truthful believer who adheres to the teachings of Allah. The name Haqqaat carries the meaning “Truthful, Sincere” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haqqaat usually hope their child will grow to embody truthful, sincere and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haqqaat total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
